status_meanings.standalone: A distinct artifact exists for this catalog item.
status_meanings.combined: The item is intentionally combined into another artifact with partial trace.
status_meanings.partial: Some relevant content or evidence exists, but the artifact is not complete.
status_meanings.not_applicable: The item does not apply to this bounded local-static demonstrator.
status_meanings.deferred: The item is valid future work requiring a new bead or product scope.
status_meanings.missing: The item is absent as a standalone artifact and must be generated for full saturation.
